sections.label: Company context
sections.text: You are the support assistant for Lumen, a developer tools company. Users are mostly software engineers.
notes: context shift: this part sets who the assistant is, so removing it changes what answers are about, not just their style

sections.label: Apology policy
sections.text: Always apologise when the user reports a problem, even if it is not our fault.

sections.label: Epistemic stance
sections.text: Be humble about uncertainty and avoid overstating what you know.

sections.label: Formatting
sections.text: Use bullet points for any steps the user should follow.

sections.label: Engagement
sections.text: Ask a follow-up question at the end so the conversation continues.

sections.label: Voice
sections.text: Be warm and encouraging toward the user.

sections.label: Length limit
notes: never tested: the longest answer was 90 words, so the 200-word limit never came into play

detectors.description: Apologising: I'm sorry, apologies, I apologize (not sympathy).

detectors.label: Sympathy
detectors.description: Sympathising with the user: sorry to hear, sorry you're…

detectors.label: Flattery
detectors.description: Praising the user or the question.

detectors.label: Hedging
detectors.description: Softening a claim: might, perhaps, possibly, it seems, I think.

detectors.label: Didn't understand
detectors.description: Saying it doesn't understand what the user means.

detectors.label: Certainty boost
detectors.description: Overstating confidence: definitely, clearly, absolutely.

detectors.label: List item
detectors.description: Bulleted or numbered list lines.

detectors.label: Heading
detectors.description: Markdown headings.

detectors.label: Bold emphasis
detectors.description: Markdown bold inside running text (not bullet lead-ins).

detectors.label: Parenthetical
detectors.description: Asides in parentheses.

detectors.label: Question back
detectors.description: Sentences addressed back to the user ending in '?'.

detectors.label: Clarification request
detectors.description: Asking the user for more context.

detectors.label: Offer of more help
detectors.description: A closing offer in the last two sentences: let me know if, happy to help.

detectors.label: Caveat
detectors.description: Sentence-initial contrast or reservation.

detectors.label: Disclaimer
detectors.description: Explicit disclaimers and warnings.

detectors.label: Metacommentary
detectors.description: Talking about the answer instead of answering.

detectors.label: AI self-reference
detectors.description: Referring to itself as an AI or model.

detectors.label: Exclamation
detectors.description: Sentences ending in '!'.

detectors.label: Emoji
detectors.description: Pictographic emoji.

detectors.label: Answer length
detectors.description: Words per answer.

detectors.label: Lines
detectors.description: Non-empty lines per answer.

detectors.label: Asks any question
detectors.description: Share of answers with at least one question.

detectors.label: Ends with a question
detectors.description: Share of answers whose last sentence is a question.

detectors.label: Uses a list
detectors.description: Share of answers with at least one list item.

detectors.label: Asks for context
detectors.description: Share of answers that ask the user for more context.
